 CHARACTER 
 256

 entityCode 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Unique Lukka code for the source entity 
 
 
 entityType 
 CHARACTER 
 20 
 Type of service provided by the source entity 
 
 
 entityDerivativeCode 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Code used by the source entity to uniquely identify the contract 
 
 
 entityDerivativeName 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Additional descriptive information provided by the source entity 
 
 
 startTime 
 DATE 
 ISO 8601 
 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the derivative contract was listed by the source entity 
 
 
 endTime 
 DATE 
 ISO 8601 
 Timestamp (UTC+0) for the expiration date of the contract provided by the source entity 
 
 
 settlementTime 
 DATE 
 ISO 8601 
 Timestamp (UTC+0) for the settlement time of the contract provided by the source entity 
 
 
 instrumentType 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Type of contract classified by the source entity 
 
 
 instrumentSubtype 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Additional information on the type of contract

 NUMERIC 
 
 Value of one point of quoted price in quote currency for one contract. Contract size in futures trading is the amount of underlying asset represented by each futures contract

 NUMERIC 
 
 Price at which the put or call option can be exercised

 CHARACTER 
 256 
 The asset in which a contract is settled 
 
 
 entityUnderlyingAssetCode 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 The asset making up the contract and upon which the price is based

 CHARACTER

 The asset by which a contract is valued

 Source entity-specific information such as underlying index, descriptive data, unique identifiers, etc.

description.content:
Get a list of all the crypto actions occurring on an asset.

 Response Details 

 
 
 
 Field Name 
 Data Type 
 Data Type Details 
 Description 
 
 
 event 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Type of crypto action 
 
 
 eventTime 
 DATE 
 ISO 8601 
 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the crypto action has taken place or will take place (for future events) 
 
 
 oldLukkaId 
 CHARACTER 
 11 
 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the crypto asset before the crypto action event. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information 
 
 
 oldWhitepaperAssetCode 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Ticker of the crypto asset found in the primary source before the crypto action event 
 
 
 oldWhitepaperAssetName 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Name of the crypto asset found in the primary source before the crypto action event 
 
 
 oldBlockchain 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Blockchain on which the asset resided before the crypto action event 
 
 
 oldContractAddress 
 CHARACTER 
 4000 
 Address of the contract of an asset in its respective blockchain before the crypto action event 
 
 
 newLukkaId 
 CHARACTER 
 11 
 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the crypto asset after the crypto action event. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information 
 
 
 newWhitepaperAssetCode 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Ticker of the crypto asset found in the primary source after the crypto action event 
 
 
 newWhitepaperAssetName 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Name of the crypto asset found in the primary source after the crypto action event 
 
 
 newBlockchain 
 CHARACTER 
 256 
 Blockchain on which the asset resides after the crypto action event 
 
 
 newContractAddress 
 CHARACTER 
 4000 
 Address of the contract of an asset in its respective blockchain after the crypto action event 
 
 
 newSplitMultiplier 
 NUMBER 
 
 Change in the balance of the new asset after a crypto action event such as an "Asset Swap" has taken place 
 
 
 eventDetails 
 CHARACTER 
 4000 
 Additional information such as a link to the website or publication of the crypto action event
